items.name: Danielle
items.text: I joined SKT in June and immediately loved it. I was nervous when I walked in, but shouldn't have been. Everyone makes you feel like family. The coaches are incredible and are always willing to help you. I have found my gym.

items.name: Janice
items.text: If I miss a class at Southside Knockout, I don't just miss the workout; I miss the camaraderie and the people. It's the perfect mix of fun and hard work. The ownership is fantastic, and the trainers are AMAZING. It's more than a workout. It's a community that keeps you coming back.

items.name: Monica
items.text: My experience with SKT Orland Park has been beyond wonderful! From the encouraging and welcoming environment to the genuine kindness of the people, this group is truly made up of Supportive Superstars! Everyone creates an atmosphere where you feel valued, uplifted, and encouraged.
